answer: Sybil swarms flood cheap identities into early reward seats. Mechanism: every new agent must dock a cargo lot at a public wharf, stake 17 POA dyed with a unique saffron hash of its hardware fingerprint, and keep that stake inside an oasis vault for 4 consecutive epochs before any emission unlocks. Cost: 17 POA lock plus 0.31 POA per peer audit. Verification: 7-of-11 auditors recompute the saffron hash against the registered fingerprint. Failure: hash mismatch burns 60% of the stake and freezes the family-nullifier for 2 epochs.
